publication.title: ARGUS-OS1 centriole biology knowledge field (MVP)
publication.description: MVP of the Noepedia field for the centriole-biology domain: pilots P0-P8 as CLAIM nodes with evidence, Go/No-Go rule cards, coverage. Source: ARGUS-OS1 CONCEPT.md.

networks.name: protocol_validity
networks.description: Which pilot protocol is valid and under what conditions.

rule_card.title: Protocol validity rule
rule_card.evaluates: whether a pilot's Go/No-Go criteria are met
rule_card.ranking_criterion: all stated thresholds must be satisfied; any failure -> descriptive only

networks.name: lineage_centriole_fate
networks.description: Does Pedigree Score predict centriole retention/elimination?

rule_card.title: Lineage-fate rule
rule_card.evaluates: independence of Pedigree Score as a predictor of centriole fate
rule_card.ranking_criterion: sister-pair design (ICC eliminated); joint model BF>10; fixed N=100; no intermediate stopping

claims.subject: P2 phototoxicity ceiling
claims.object: division_rate > 90% of dark control at chosen interval

claims.subject: P6 SAS-1 -> SAS-4 latency
claims.object: mean latency <15min; variance <30% of mean; predicts SAS-4 loss in >80% of cells
claims.valid_in: somatic C. elegans; oogenesis comparison (Pierron 2023) pending

evidence.description: All 3 criteria required for valid marker; else descriptive only

claims.subject: H1 Pedigree Score predicts centriole fate
claims.object: centriole retention at 100-cell window (beyond cell type, cytoplasm, age)

evidence.description: most lineages stochastic (57/43) — Pedigree Score must capture info beyond stochasticity
~5 same-type pairs/embryo -> ~500 pairs across 100 embryos; power >80% for OR>=1.5
